original.statement: The alpha, unmaintained external secret stores feature is removed in Crossplane v2; users must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-0c1262a1a2a5] sits under the upgrade guide's "Removed features › External secret stores" heading. It says that anyone using external secret stores must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading. That is a required operator step, so the migration family with migration-required fits. The name "external-secret-stores" is built in kebab-case from the evidence's own words.
